schools.text: Ryerse says public schools should be strengthened and their teachers supported.
schools.quote: A child's future shouldn't depend on their zip code, which is why we must strengthen public schools and support the teachers who make them work.

guns.text: Ryerse says gun laws should protect children at school and reduce violence in communities.
guns.quote: Safety shouldn't be a gamble, which is why we need gun laws that protect kids at school and reduce violence in our communities.

abortion.text: Ryerse says politicians should not control personal decisions about people’s bodies, health, and lives.
abortion.quote: People should be free to make their own personal decisions, which means keeping politicians out of choices about their bodies, their health, and their lives.

health.text: Ryerse calls health care a human right and supports Medicare for All so people are not denied care because of cost.
health.quote: Health care is a human right, which means Medicare for All so no one is denied care because of cost.

energy.text: Ryerse supports investing in clean energy and taking bold action to address climate change.
energy.quote: We need real, bold action on climate—with strong goals, smart policies, and the courage to stand up to big polluters.

voting.text: Ryerse supports expanding early voting, secure vote-by-mail, and automatic voter registration.
voting.quote: We should make voting easier, not harder—by expanding early voting, using secure vote-by-mail, and making registration automatic.

tax.text: Said the Working Families Tax Cuts law delivered historic tax cuts and voted for a subsequent farm bill that referenced those cuts.
tax.quote: delivering historic tax cuts and needed reforms to our social programs last year in the Working Families Tax Cuts law

wages.text: Introduced legislation that preserves the tipped-wage system and limits federal requirements on how tipped employees are classified and paid.
wages.quote: Preserves the tipped wage and the protection in the FLSA for tipped employees to receive at least the minimum wage

trade.text: Voted for a farm bill that he said addressed trade barriers and increased funding for agricultural market access and trade promotion.
trade.quote: Today’s package completes our unfinished business by tackling trade barriers

debt.text: Introduced a bipartisan budget bill that would create a fiscal commission and pursue long-term deficit and debt reduction.
debt.quote: Establishing an 18-member bipartisan commission to aid in identifying and developing policies to achieve a 3 percent annual deficit-to-GDP ratio within 10 years and work towards long-term fiscal stabilization.

safety.text: Supported increased funding for the DEA and law-enforcement programs addressing narcotics trafficking and the opioid crisis.
safety.quote: Increasing funding for the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) to end the trafficking of fentanyl and other illicit drugs

immigration.text: Voted for legislation providing $38.5 billion for Immigration and Customs Enforcement and $26 billion for Customs and Border Protection.
immigration.quote: Our federal immigration enforcement agencies carry out a crucial mission to protect our homeland and uphold the rule of law.

guns.text: Cosponsored and voted for a bill prohibiting financial institutions from using merchant codes to distinguish firearms retailers.
guns.quote: The right to bear arms is a fundamental freedom for every law-abiding American.

abortion.text: Voted for appropriations legislation maintaining the Hyde Amendment and prohibiting federal funding for abortion.
abortion.quote: Protecting the right to life by maintaining the Hyde Amendment, which prohibits taxpayer funding for abortion.

health.text: Supported extending access to Medicare telehealth services and reauthorizing funding for community health centers.
health.quote: Extending access to telehealth services for Medicare beneficiaries through January 30, 2026

energy.text: Supported appropriations provisions prohibiting federal funding for climate initiatives and green mandates, while also supporting assistance to make electric bills more affordable.
energy.quote: Prohibiting federal government funding of climate change initiatives and other green new scam-style mandates

voting.text: Voted for the SAVE America Act, which would require proof of citizenship for federal voter registration, photo identification at voting, and removal of noncitizens from voter rolls.
voting.quote: The SAVE America Act provides the safeguards needed to help ensure this standard is upheld.
